sample.task: how many fights artur beterbiev has for amateurs
sample.chosen:
There are various estimates available regarding how many amateur fights the professional boxer, Artur Beterbiev, participated in. 

According to one site purporting to be his official website, Beterbiev participated in several hundred fights and lost only a few of them, though a precise number is not given. Several other sources state that he fought in more than 300 amateur fights without giving an exact number, while others indicate an amateur record of 295-5. In contrast, the BoxRec website lists Beterbiev as having participated in 106 amateur bouts. 

As such, various sources give conflicting information regarding Beterbiev's amateur career. Nonetheless, most sources indicate that he fought in 300 or more amateur fights.
